content.value: Look at the following algorithm that normalizes the elements of an array (A) of 10 numbers (13) with respect to the average value using a cache having 8 blocks. Each block consists of only one 16-bit word and the memory is word addressable with 16-bit address.

$$
S U M : = S U M + A ( 1 , j )
$$

$$
\tt A V E : \ = \nabla \font \dot { S } U M / 1 0
$$
i) Find contents of cache after each operation when followed associative mapping technique.
ii) Again find the contents of cache for the second loop in reverse order (i.e., for i = 9 to 0).
